detail.title: Account details
detail.profileHint: Choose which Kiro profile this account uses. A pinned profile is not changed by token refresh.
detail.profileNone: No Kiro profile is available for this account.
detail.profileUnsupported: Kiro profiles exist only for Enterprise (IAM Identity Center) and Microsoft SSO accounts.
detail.profilePinnedTo: The account now uses the {region} profile.
detail.profileAutoRestored: The profile is chosen automatically again.
detail.machineIdError: Enter a UUID or 32 hex characters, or leave the field empty.
detail.generateFailed: Could not generate a machine ID.
detail.weightHint: 0 or 1 is normal. An account with weight N takes about N times as many new requests.
detail.priorityHint: 0 to 999. In priority routing, a lower number gets new requests first. Accounts with the same number follow the list order.
detail.overageHint: This calls AWS and changes the real Kiro overage setting of this account.
detail.overageSwitchFailed: Could not change the overage setting.
detail.proxyHint: Leave empty to use the global proxy.
detail.proxyHintPool: Leave empty to use the proxy pool.
detail.proxyPasswordKept: The saved password shows as ********. Leave it unchanged to keep it.
detail.proxyFormatError: Enter a URL such as socks5://host:1080. It starts with socks5://, socks5h://, http:// or https://, then a host and a port from 1 to 65535.

forecast.runsOut: At about {rate} credits a day, the credits run out {relative} ({date}), before they reset.
forecast.lasts: At about {rate} credits a day, the credits last until they reset.
forecast.lastsLeftOver: At about {rate} credits a day, about {left} credits will be left unused when they reset.
forecast.idle: No credits used in the last {days} days.

duplicates.noticeDescription: Some Kiro users were added more than once. Copies of one user share one set of credits, so the extra copies add no credits. Review them and keep one account per user.
duplicates.title: Duplicate accounts
duplicates.description: Some Kiro users were added more than once.
duplicates.pointCredits: Copies of one user share one set of credits, so the extra copies add no credits.
duplicates.pointChoose: For each user, choose the account to keep. Users you leave out of the merge stay as they are.
duplicates.pointMerge: Merge deletes the other copies and moves their requests and stats to the account you keep.
duplicates.pointBackup: A backup is saved first. Restoring it in Backups returns all accounts and settings to how they were before the merge, so later changes, such as refreshed tokens, are lost.
duplicates.reason.email: same email with the same sign-in method
duplicates.mergeSuccess_one: Merged the duplicates and deleted {count} extra copy. A backup was saved first.
duplicates.mergeSuccess_other: Merged the duplicates and deleted {count} extra copies. A backup was saved first.
